ui_bugs.issue: Initial pageload of /comparison threw 'TRADES is not defined' then 'ACTIVE_RUN is not defined' — same pattern as iteration-2 SweepLab bug. /app/frontend/src/pages/ComparisonLab.jsx line 24 destructured `{ RUNS, EQUITY_CURVE, MONTHLY }` from useDataset() but later referenced `TRADES` (line 44) and `ACTIVE_RUN` (line 47) which were never imported from the dataset hook. Page rendered empty (body_len=18). FIXED by testing agent: destructure now `{ RUNS, EQUITY_CURVE, MONTHLY, TRADES, ACTIVE_RUN } = useDataset()`. Verified all KPI rows render correctly after fix.

Persistent 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' console warnings on initial render. Cosmetic only — charts display correctly after layout settles. Carried over from iteration 2.

action_items: Audit ALL pages that destructure values from useDataset() inside the parent component for any references to identifiers that were not destructured. This pattern caused both iteration-2 (/sweep) and iteration-3 (/comparison) regressions. Consider adding an error boundary around route content so single-page exceptions do not blank the route silently.
Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning floods the console — investigate by adding explicit minWidth/minHeight or initial dimensions to ResponsiveContainer parents.
